description: DB + shared-contract foundation: the hand-authored phase3_classes migration (9 tenant-owned tables with RLS + composite FKs + CHECKs + append-only revision trigger + catalogue seed), the matching Prisma schema models/enums, the classes.* permission catalogue + FACULTY template role, the classes.* audit keys, and the Phase-3 Zod request schemas. This is the base every later FEAT builds on; it must be applied to the live DB and generate a clean Prisma Client before FEAT-002 starts. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 only in the sense that they all depend on it — it comes first.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/phase3-classes/context.json and design.md FIRST (esp. §6 schema, §6.1 enums, §6.10 FK table, §7 permissions, §9 audit, §10 validation, §11 migration sections a-j). Do not re-explore what context.json already states.

Create a new timestamped migration dir packages/db/prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_phase3_classes/ AFTER 20261027161616_phase2_sis (do NOT edit the 8 FROZEN dirs). Hand-author migration.sql in the phase2_sis house style, sections a-j: (a) CREATE TYPE the 9 enums from §6.1; (b) CREATE TABLE courses, subjects, class_sections, class_enrollments, faculty_profiles, faculty_assignments, timetables, scheduled_classes (8 mutable) + schedule_revisions (append-only) with PKs; (c) unique indexes — each table's (id,institutionId), the business uniques (courses(institutionId,code), subjects(institutionId,code), class_sections(institutionId,programId,academicSessionId,academicTermId,label), class_enrollments(classSectionId,studentId), faculty_profiles(userId)) + every @@index([institutionId]) + the §6 query indexes; (d) tenant-root FKs institutionId->institutions(id) RESTRICT on all 9; (e) composite same-tenant FKs per §6.10 (RESTRICT/SET NULL exactly as tabled, referencing parents' (id,institutionId) uniques); (f) CHECK constraints on scheduled_classes (startTime>=0 AND startTime<1440, endTime>0 AND endTime<=1440, startTime<endTime, ((dayOfWeek IS NULL) <> (date IS NULL))); (g) ENABLE+FORCE RLS on all 9 — standard nullif-guarded {tenant_isolation_select, tenant_isolation_modify} on the 8 mutable tables, append-only {tenant_isolation_select, schedule_revisions_tenant_insert} (NO modify policy) on schedule_revisions; (h) append-only function + BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger on schedule_revisions raising restrict_violation (copy the student_profile_history precedent); (i) guarded IF EXISTS pg_roles campass_app GRANT refresh — full DML on the 8 mutable tables, GRANT SELECT,INSERT + REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE on schedule_revisions, never BYPASSRLS; (j) seed the 7 classes.* permissions + role_permissions pairs with the EXACT catalogue-sync markers, emitting the FACULTY roles INSERT (id,key,name,institutionId VALUES (...,'FACULTY','Faculty',NULL) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) BEFORE the INSERT INTO "permissions" block (§11j parser safety).

Mirror the 9 models + 9 enums into packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma exactly as §6 (relations + scalars only; RLS/FK/trigger/CHECK stay in SQL). Reuse ProgramStatus for Course.status and Subject.status (§6.2). On schedule_revisions, actorUserId/actorMembershipId are recorded id columns with NO FK (§6.10 NIT-1).

Add the 7 classes.* keys to PERMISSIONS (module 'classes') in packages/shared/src/permissions.ts and wire ROLE_PERMISSIONS: ADMIN=all 7; HOD=all 7; FACULTY=classes.view_own ONLY; STUDENT=add classes.view_own (§7/A4). Keep the shared map and the migration §11j seed in lockstep (catalogue-sync set-equality).
Add the past-tense classes.* audit-action keys to AUDIT_ACTIONS in packages/shared/src/audit-actions.ts exactly as design §9 (module 'classes').
Add TEMPLATE_ROLE_NAMES['FACULTY']='Faculty' in packages/db/src/seed.ts so seedRbacCatalogue names the new template role (demo seed rows themselves are FEAT-004).

Add the Phase-3 Zod request schemas to packages/shared/src/validation.ts (one per create/update body per §10, incl. the scheduled-class dayOfWeek-XOR-date .refine, startTime<endTime, minute bounds; faculty-assignment optional replacesAssignmentId; timetable create + publish).
Add the new '<timestamp>_phase3_classes' dir name to SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS in apps/api/src/services/__tests__/catalogue-sync.test.ts so the meta-test parses the new §11j seed block.
Verify DDL read-only, apply, confirm; regenerate the client; build shared; run catalogue-sync.
acceptance_criteria: `npx prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --to-migrations prisma/migrations --exit-code` (run in packages/db) reports NO drift between schema.prisma and the migrations (schema and hand-authored SQL agree).

`npx prisma migrate deploy` applies the new dir cleanly and `npx prisma migrate status` shows 'Database schema is up to date', the new dir listed as applied, the 8 prior dirs untouched, and NO _prisma_migrations duplicates.
`npm run db:generate -w @campusgate/db` regenerates Prisma Client with the 9 new models + 9 enums and no errors.
`npm run build -w @campusgate/shared` (tsc) passes with the new permissions, audit keys, and Zod schemas.

`npm test -w @campusgate/api -- catalogue-sync` passes: the migration §11j seed keys + role_permission pairs union equals ROLE_PERMISSIONS/PERMISSION_KEYS (requires the SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS edit — add the new dir name here as part of this FEAT so the meta-test is green).
The 8 FROZEN migration dirs and the _prisma_migrations ledger are byte-for-byte untouched.
verification: cd packages/db; npx prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --to-migrations prisma/migrations --exit-code
cd packages/db; npx prisma migrate deploy; npx prisma migrate status
findings:
COMPLETED. Handoff facts for later FEATs:

- NEW MIGRATION DIR: 20261028000000_phase3_classes (timestamp chosen strictly after 20261027161616_phase2_sis; the 8 frozen dirs are untouched). Applied via `prisma migrate deploy`; `migrate status` = 'Database schema is up to date', no ledger duplicates.

- 9 TABLES (8 mutable + 1 append-only): courses, subjects, class_sections, class_enrollments, faculty_profiles, faculty_assignments, timetables, scheduled_classes (standard RLS pair {tenant_isolation_select, tenant_isolation_modify}); schedule_revisions (append-only pair {tenant_isolation_select, schedule_revisions_tenant_insert}, NO modify policy, BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger schedule_revisions_no_update_delete via fn schedule_revisions_append_only raising restrict_violation, campass_app REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE).

- 9 ENUMS: ClassSectionStatus, EnrollmentStatus, FacultyStatus, FacultyAssignmentRole, FacultyAssignmentStatus, TimetableStatus, ScheduledClassStatus, DayOfWeek (SUN..SAT, SUN=0 ordinal), ScheduleRevisionChangeType. Course.status + Subject.status REUSE the existing ProgramStatus enum (ACTIVE|INACTIVE), not a new enum.

- scheduled_classes CHECKs: scheduled_classes_startTime_bounds_check (0<=startTime<1440), scheduled_classes_endTime_bounds_check (0<endTime<=1440), scheduled_classes_start_before_end_check (startTime<endTime), scheduled_classes_day_xor_date_check ((dayOfWeek IS NULL) <> (date IS NULL)).

- 7 PERMISSION KEYS (module 'classes'): classes.courses.manage, classes.sections.manage, classes.enroll, classes.faculty.assign, classes.timetable.manage, classes.view, classes.view_own. ROLE_PERMISSIONS: ADMIN=all 7; HOD=all 7; FACULTY=classes.view_own ONLY; STUDENT=classes.view_own. New FACULTY template role seeded (roles id 'role_template_faculty', key 'FACULTY', name 'Faculty', institutionId NULL) BEFORE the permissions INSERT block (catalogue-sync parser safety). Shared ROLE_PERMISSIONS now has a FACULTY key = ['classes.view_own']. seed.ts TEMPLATE_ROLE_NAMES['FACULTY']='Faculty' added.

- 18 AUDIT KEYS (module 'classes', past-tense, AUDIT_ACTIONS only, no migration mirror): classes.course.created/updated, classes.subject.created/updated, classes.section.created/updated, classes.enrollment.enrolled/dropped, classes.faculty.profile_created, classes.faculty.assigned/substituted/unassigned, classes.timetable.created/published/archived, classes.scheduled_class.added/updated/cancelled. NOTE the permission key 'classes.faculty.assign' (present tense) is a PERMISSION only; its audit counterpart is 'classes.faculty.assigned'.

- ZOD SCHEMAS added to packages/shared/src/validation.ts (+ enums classSectionStatusEnum, facultyAssignmentRoleEnum, dayOfWeekEnum): createCourseSchema/updateCourseSchema, createSubjectSchema/updateSubjectSchema, createClassSectionSchema/updateClassSectionSchema, enrollClassSchema, createFacultyProfileSchema, createFacultyAssignmentSchema (optional replacesAssignmentId), createScheduledClassSchema/updateScheduledClassSchema (dayOfWeek-XOR-date .refine, startTime<endTime .refine, minute bounds [0,1440]), createTimetableSchema, publishTimetableSchema (optional acceptWarnings). Update schemas are .strict().

- SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS in apps/api/src/services/__tests__/catalogue-sync.test.ts now includes '20261028000000_phase3_classes'.

- SCHEMA MODELING NOTE: schema.prisma declares single-column Prisma relations (references: [id]); the composite same-tenant (institutionId,col) FKs live ONLY in the migration SQL per the house style (as every frozen table already does). `prisma migrate diff --to-schema-datasource` therefore reports FK-representation-only differences for ALL tables (new and pre-existing) — this is NOT drift; there is no table/column/index difference. `migrate status` 'up to date' is the authoritative signal. schedule_revisions.actorUserId/actorMembershipId are recorded id columns with NO FK.
